name: GJ 436
description: Star of 3,505 K, 9.75 parsecs away, with 1 transiting planet.

text.card: GJ 436 b crosses GJ 436 as seen from Earth, which is how it was found.
text.introduction: Its radius follows Maciejewski et al. 2014, and its temperature Maxted et al. 2022.

quotes.title: Gliese 436
quotes.card: Gliese 436, also known as Noquisi, is a red dwarf located 31.9 light-years away in the zodiac constellation of Leo.
quotes.introduction: It has an apparent visual magnitude of 10.67, which is much too faint to be seen with the naked eye.
